layers.name: Entry Points
layers.description: Process entry points that bootstrap the application (server, probe, seed).

layers.name: Domain Layer
layers.description: Pure business entities, value objects, and domain errors — no external dependencies.

layers.name: Use Case Layer
layers.description: Application orchestration: network use cases (execute command, stream) and business use cases (manage customers, subscriptions, billing).

layers.name: Port Contracts
layers.description: Interface contracts (repositories, drivers, gateways) that adapters implement.

layers.name: Adapter Layer

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Polyglot is a NetOps + ISP management backend exposing MCP, REST, and WebSocket/SSE interfaces for multi-vendor network automation (Mikrotik, Cisco, generic SSH/Telnet, OLT vendors).

tour.title: Application Entry Points
tour.description: The process starts here: the server binary boots configuration, database, Redis, auth, device drivers, and ConnectRPC services; probe runs connectivity checks; seed populates initial data.

tour.title: Core Infrastructure — App Assembly
tour.description: internal/app wires every layer together: dependencies, routers, and lifecycle management.

tour.title: Configuration & Crypto
tour.description: Environment-driven configuration with validation, plus AES credential vault crypto helpers.

tour.title: Domain Layer — Business Entities
tour.description: Pure domain entities and rules with zero external dependencies: device, command, session, customer, subscription, billing.

tour.title: Port Contracts
tour.description: Interfaces that decouple use cases from implementations: device drivers, repositories, credential vault, audit writer, LLM provider, WhatsApp gateway.

tour.title: Use Case Layer — Orchestration
tour.description: Application logic: execute commands, stream device output, manage customers/subscriptions/billing, hotspot operations.

tour.title: Adapter Layer — HTTP/ConnectRPC & MCP
tour.description: Concrete protocol adapters: ConnectRPC services, MCP tools, WebSocket handlers, Postgres repositories, Redis cache, auth (JWT + Casbin RBAC).

tour.title: Device Drivers & Registry
tour.description: Vendor-specific drivers translate abstract operations into native commands: Mikrotik, Cisco, generic SSH/CLI, OLT vendors, GenieACS. The registry routes devices to the right driver.

tour.title: API Contracts — Protobuf & ConnectRPC
tour.description: Service contracts defined in protobuf and exposed via ConnectRPC: device, hotspot, customer, billing, bot, knowledge, RBAC, WhatsApp.

tour.title: Data Layer — Migrations
tour.description: SQL migrations define the schema: devices, users, conversations, vouchers, knowledge, technicians, and more.

tour.title: Shared Libraries & Docs
tour.description: Reusable generic packages (retry, voucher generation) and the architecture/ADR documentation.

tour.title: Deployment & CI
tour.description: Docker image, Compose manifests, and GitHub Actions CI that build and ship the server.
